entities.name: Tobit
entities.brief: Pious Naphtalite exile at Nineveh, father of Tobias
entities.short: Tobit, a righteous Israelite of Naphtali deported to Nineveh, gives alms and buries the dead, is blinded, and is healed through his son Tobias.

entities.name: Anna
entities.short: Anna, Tobit's wife of his own kindred, works to support the family during his blindness and watches anxiously for Tobias's return.

entities.name: Tobias
entities.brief: Son of Tobit who journeys with Raphael and marries Sarah
entities.short: Tobias, son of Tobit and Anna, travels to Media with the angel Raphael, binds the demon Asmodaeus, marries Sarah, and heals his father's blindness.

entities.name: Tobiel
entities.short: Tobiel is the first named forebear in Tobit's genealogy, a member of the tribe of Naphtali.

entities.name: Ananiel
entities.short: Ananiel appears in Tobit's genealogy, son of Aduel.

entities.name: Aduel
entities.short: Aduel appears in Tobit's genealogy, son of Gabael.

entities.name: Gabael (ancestor)
entities.short: Gabael appears in Tobit's genealogy, son of Asiel.

entities.name: Asiel
entities.short: Asiel is the earliest forebear named in Tobit's genealogy, of the tribe of Naphtali.

entities.name: Deborah
entities.short: Deborah is Tobit's father's mother, who commanded him in giving the third tithe after he was orphaned.

entities.name: Anael
entities.short: Anael is Tobit's brother, named as the father of Achiacharus.

entities.name: Achiacharus
entities.brief: Tobit's nephew, chief minister at Nineveh
entities.short: Achiacharus, Tobit's nephew, is made chief of accounts under King Esarhaddon and supports Tobit in his blindness.

entities.name: Nasbas
entities.brief: Achiacharus's nephew, guest at Tobias's wedding
entities.short: Nasbas is the nephew of Achiacharus, who comes with him to Tobias's wedding feast.

entities.name: Gabael of Rages
entities.brief: Tobit's debtor at Rages who returns the silver
entities.short: Gabael, brother of Gabrias at Rages in Media, holds Tobit's ten talents of silver and returns it to Tobias.

entities.name: Gabrias
entities.short: Gabrias is the brother of Gabael, through whom Tobit's silver was deposited.

entities.name: Raguel
entities.brief: Sarah's father, Tobit's kinsman at Ecbatana
entities.short: Raguel of Ecbatana, a kinsman of Tobit, is Sarah's father and gives her in marriage to Tobias.

entities.name: Edna
entities.short: Edna, wife of Raguel and mother of Sarah, welcomes Tobias and blesses the marriage.

entities.name: Sarah
entities.brief: Daughter of Raguel, wife of Tobias
entities.short: Sarah, afflicted by the demon Asmodaeus who killed her seven husbands, is freed through prayer and marries Tobias.

entities.name: Raphael
entities.brief: Angel sent by God to heal Tobit and Sarah
entities.short: The archangel Raphael travels with Tobias disguised as Azarias, then reveals himself as one of the seven angels who present the prayers of the saints.

entities.name: Asmodaeus
entities.brief: Evil spirit who kills Sarah's husbands
entities.short: Asmodaeus, the evil spirit loving Sarah, killed her seven husbands before being driven off and bound by Raphael.

entities.name: Ananias the great
entities.brief: Name Raphael gives as his father
entities.short: Ananias, called great, is the false father Raphael invents for himself as Azarias; Tobit says he knew him.

entities.name: Jathan
entities.brief: Kinsman Tobit remembers, son of Shemaiah
entities.short: Jathan is a son of Shemaiah the great, remembered by Tobit from journeys to Jerusalem.

entities.name: Shemaiah
entities.short: Shemaiah the great is named by Tobit as father of Ananias and Jathan.

entities.name: Manasses
entities.brief: Man who gave alms and escaped Aman's snare
entities.short: Manasses, who gave alms, is cited in Tobit's dying counsel as escaping the death trap set by Aman.

entities.name: Aman
entities.brief: Wicked man who plotted against Achiacharus
entities.short: Aman, who tried to ruin Achiacharus, is cited in Tobit's last words as having fallen into his own snare.

entities.name: Ahasuerus (Tobit)
entities.brief: King who with Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Nineveh
entities.short: Ahasuerus, named beside Nebuchadnezzar, helped capture Nineveh; likely the Median king Cyaxares.

entities.name: Rages
entities.brief: Median city where Tobit left silver with Gabael
entities.short: Rages, a city of Media, is where Tobit deposited his ten talents and where Gabael lived; also called Ragau in Judith.

entities.name: Thisbe
entities.short: Thisbe, south-east of Kedesh Naphtali in Galilee, is the hometown from which Tobit was carried into captivity.

entities.name: Pentecost
entities.brief: Feast of Weeks at which Tobit's meal was prepared
entities.short: Pentecost, the holy feast of Weeks, is the day on which Tobit sent Tobias to find a poor man to share his dinner.

entities.name: Hades
entities.brief: Realm of the dead in the Song of the Three
entities.short: Hades is the realm of the dead from which the three young men say God has rescued them.

entities.name: Judith
entities.brief: Widow of Bethulia who beheads Holofernes
entities.short: Judith, a pious and beautiful widow of Bethulia, enters the Assyrian camp and kills Holofernes, delivering her town and Israel.

entities.name: Merari (Judith's father)
entities.short: Merari is named as Judith's father in her genealogy.

entities.name: Ox
entities.short: Ox appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Merari.

entities.name: Joseph (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Joseph appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Ox.

entities.name: Oziel
entities.short: Oziel appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Joseph.

entities.name: Elkiah
entities.short: Elkiah appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Oziel.

entities.name: Ananias (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Ananias appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Elkiah.

entities.name: Gideon (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Gideon appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Ananias, not the judge of that name.

entities.name: Raphaim
entities.short: Raphaim appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Gideon.

entities.name: Ahitub (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Ahitub appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Raphaim.

entities.name: Elihu
entities.short: Elihu appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Ahitub.

entities.name: Eliab (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Eliab appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Elihu.

entities.name: Nathanael (Judith's ancestor)
entities.short: Nathanael appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Eliab.

entities.name: Salamiel
entities.short: Salamiel appears in Judith's genealogy as father of Nathanael.

entities.name: Salasadai
entities.short: Salasadai appears in Judith's genealogy as son of Israel and father of Salamiel.

entities.name: Manasses (Judith's husband)
entities.brief: Judith's late husband, died in the barley harvest
entities.short: Manasses, of Judith's tribe, died of sunstroke at the barley harvest, leaving her a wealthy widow.

entities.name: Holofernes
entities.short: Holofernes, chief general of Nebuchadnezzar, leads the campaign to the west and is beheaded by Judith in his tent.

entities.name: Bagoas
entities.short: Bagoas, the eunuch in charge of Holofernes's affairs, arranges Judith's banquet and finds his master's headless body.

entities.name: Achior
entities.brief: Ammonite leader who warns Holofernes about Israel
entities.short: Achior, leader of the Ammonites, tells Holofernes of Israel's history and God, is handed over to Bethulia, and later converts.

entities.name: Arphaxad
entities.short: Arphaxad, king of the Medes who built Ecbatana, is overcome and killed by Nebuchadnezzar in the mountains of Ragau.

entities.name: Arioch
entities.brief: King of the Elymaeans in Judith
entities.short: Arioch is the king of the Elymaeans whose plain is named among the allies of Nebuchadnezzar.

entities.name: Chelod
entities.short: The sons of Chelod are among the nations summoned to Nebuchadnezzar's war.

entities.name: Ozias
entities.short: Ozias, son of Micah of the tribe of Simeon, is a ruler of Bethulia who receives Achior and agrees to a five-day delay before surrender.

entities.name: Micah
entities.short: Micah is named as the father of Ozias.

entities.name: Chabris
entities.brief: Elder of Bethulia, son of Gothoniel
entities.short: Chabris is one of the three elders of Bethulia with Ozias and Charmis.

entities.name: Gothoniel
entities.short: Gothoniel is named as the father of Chabris.

entities.name: Charmis
entities.brief: Elder of Bethulia, son of Melchiel
entities.short: Charmis is one of the three elders of Bethulia with Ozias and Chabris.

entities.name: Melchiel
entities.short: Melchiel is named as the father of Charmis.

entities.name: Joakim the high priest
entities.brief: High priest at Jerusalem during the crisis
entities.short: Joakim, high priest at Jerusalem, orders the defence of the hill passes and later comes to honour Judith.

entities.name: Bethulia
entities.brief: Hill town besieged by Holofernes, home of Judith
entities.short: Bethulia, a fortified town opposite Esdraelon overlooking the pass to Judea, is besieged by Holofernes; its site is unidentified.

entities.name: Esdraelon
entities.short: Esdraelon, the plain of Jezreel in northern Israel, is where Holofernes camps near Dothan and Bethulia faces it.

entities.name: Antilibanus
entities.short: Antilibanus is the mountain range east of Lebanon, named among the regions summoned by Nebuchadnezzar.

entities.name: Put
entities.short: Put, likely Libya or a nearby region, is plundered along with Lud in Holofernes's campaign.

entities.name: Lud
entities.short: Lud, probably in Asia Minor, is plundered together with Put by Holofernes.

entities.name: Bectileth
entities.short: Bectileth is a plain three days from Nineveh near the mountains of Upper Cilicia.

entities.name: Arbonai
entities.short: The river Arbonai lies on Holofernes's route to Mesopotamia and the sea.

entities.name: Hydaspes
entities.brief: River in the east in Judith
entities.short: The Hydaspes is named among the rivers of Nebuchadnezzar's summoned territories.

entities.name: Chellians
entities.brief: Land south of the wilderness plundered by Holofernes
entities.short: The land of the Chellians lies on the southern edge of the wilderness in Holofernes's campaign.

entities.name: Betane
entities.short: Betane is named among the places beyond Jordan to which Nebuchadnezzar sent messengers.

entities.name: Chellus
entities.short: Chellus is named among the places in the summoning list near Kadesh.

entities.name: Beth-horon (Judith)
entities.brief: Pass town warned to defend against Assyria
entities.short: Beth-horon, a pass town northwest of Jerusalem, is among the places Israel alerts.

entities.name: Konae
entities.brief: Place warned to defend against Assyria
entities.short: Konae is named among the places Israel alerts to the Assyrian advance.

entities.name: Belmaim
entities.brief: Town alerted to the invasion near Dothan
entities.short: Belmaim is alerted to the invasion and later the Assyrians control the spring-fed ridge there.

entities.name: Choba
entities.brief: Place warned to defend against Assyria
entities.short: Choba (Chobai) is a town warned of the Assyrian advance, and the place to which the Assyrians were pursued.

entities.name: Aesora
entities.brief: Place warned to defend against Assyria
entities.short: Aesora is named among the places Israel alerts.

entities.name: Salem (valley)
entities.short: The valley of Salem is named among the places alerted to hold the passes.

entities.name: Betomesthaim
entities.short: Betomesthaim lies opposite Esdraelon near Dothan; its people are warned and later help pursue the Assyrians.

entities.name: Cyamon
entities.short: Cyamon is named as lying opposite Esdraelon in the army's encampment.

entities.name: Chola
entities.brief: Place named in the pursuit of the Assyrians
entities.short: Chola is among the places beyond which the Israelites chased the fleeing army.

entities.name: Ekrebel
entities.short: Ekrebel is a location where Edom and Ammon camped near the brook Mochmur.

entities.name: Chusi
entities.short: Chusi lies near Ekrebel, on the brook Mochmur.

entities.name: Mochmur
entities.short: The brook Mochmur is where the Edomite and Ammonite allies camped.

entities.name: Zion
entities.short: Zion is the holy mountain of God, named in Judith's prayer.

entities.name: Titans
entities.short: The Titans are named in Judith's song to say Holofernes did not fall to mighty sons of Titans.

entities.name: India
entities.brief: Eastern limit of the Persian empire
entities.short: India marks the eastern edge of Ahasuerus's realm, from India to Ethiopia.

entities.name: Nisan
entities.brief: First month of the Jewish year
entities.short: Nisan is the first month, in which Mordecai's dream is dated and the decree for the Jews is written.

entities.name: Adar
entities.brief: Twelfth month, appointed for the Jews' deliverance
entities.short: Adar is the twelfth month; the fourteenth and fifteenth are kept as days of Purim.

entities.name: Purim
entities.brief: Festival commemorating the deliverance of the Jews
entities.short: Purim is the feast on 14-15 Adar celebrating Esther and Mordecai's deliverance; the final colophon calls this letter the letter of Purim.

entities.name: Bazan
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Tharrha
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Baraze
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Zatholtha
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Abataza
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Tharaba
entities.short: One of the king's seven chamberlains named in the Greek text of Esther.

entities.name: Gabatha
entities.brief: Conspiring eunuch in Mordecai's dream account
entities.short: Named in the Greek text of Esther as a servant or noble of King Ahasuerus.

entities.name: Arkesaeus
entities.short: Named in the Greek text of Esther as a servant or noble of King Ahasuerus.

entities.name: Sarsathaeus
entities.short: Named in the Greek text of Esther as a servant or noble of King Ahasuerus.

entities.name: Malisear
entities.short: Named in the Greek text of Esther as a servant or noble of King Ahasuerus.

entities.name: Bugathan
entities.short: Named in the Greek text of Esther as a servant or noble of King Ahasuerus.

entities.name: Phasga
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Delphon
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Pharsannes
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Pharadatha
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Barea
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Sarbaca
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Marmasima
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Ruphaeus
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Arsaeus
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Zabuthaeus
entities.brief: Son of Haman, killed at Susa
entities.short: One of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews at Susa.

entities.name: Dositheus
entities.brief: Priest who brought the Greek Esther to Egypt
entities.short: Dositheus, who claimed to be a priest and Levite, brought the Greek letter of Purim to Egypt with his son Ptolemeus.

entities.name: Ptolemeus (son of Dositheus)
entities.brief: Son of Dositheus, accompanied his father
entities.short: Ptolemeus, son of Dositheus, came with him to deliver the Greek Esther; the colophon also names Ptolemeus the king and Lysimachus's father by this name.

entities.name: Cleopatra
entities.brief: Queen of Egypt in the colophon of Greek Esther
entities.short: Cleopatra, with Ptolemeus, is named in dating the arrival of the Greek Esther in the fourth year of their reign.

entities.name: Lysimachus
entities.brief: Jerusalem translator of the Greek Esther
entities.short: Lysimachus, son of Ptolemeus in Jerusalem, is credited with interpreting the letter of Purim.

entities.name: Joakim (Susanna's husband)
entities.brief: Wealthy Jew of Babylon, husband of Susanna
entities.short: Joakim, a rich and honoured Jew in Babylon, is the husband of Susanna and owner of the garden where the elders accost her.

entities.name: Susanna
entities.brief: Righteous wife falsely accused by two elders
entities.short: Susanna, daughter of Helkias, is falsely accused by two lecherous elders, but is rescued by the young Daniel's cross-examination.

entities.name: Helkias
entities.short: Helkias is the father of Susanna, who with his wife praises God for her vindication.

entities.name: Astyages
entities.brief: King gathered to his fathers before Cyrus
entities.short: Astyages, the last Median king, is named at the opening of Bel and the Dragon as succeeded by Cyrus the Persian.

entities.name: Bel
entities.short: Bel, the idol of the Babylonians, is revealed as a fraud when ashes on the temple floor show the footprints of its priests.

entities.name: The Dragon
entities.brief: Serpent worshiped at Babylon, killed by Daniel
entities.short: The dragon is a living creature worshipped in Babylon, which Daniel kills by feeding it cakes of pitch, fat and hair.
